articles.title: 欧几里得望远镜发现首颗新彗星 C/2026 S1
articles.summary: 欧空局10月19日公布，欧几里得空间望远镜在9月16日至24日拍摄的图像中发现其首颗此前未知彗星 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)，经国际天文联合会小行星中心确认。该彗星距地球约13亿公里，轨道周期达数千年。
articles.new_facts: 欧空局10月19日宣布，欧几里得空间望远镜在2026年9月16日至24日拍摄的图像中发现首颗此前未知彗星，编号 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)。发现由赫尔辛基大学博士生 Mikko Pöntinen 利用其开发的移动天体检测软件完成，在5个视野、共16次曝光中捕捉到目标。国际天文联合会小行星中心经地面后续观测后于10月8日确认其为彗星。该彗星距地球约13亿公里，位于行星轨道平面之外，绕太阳周期达数千年。欧空局称其不适合作为未来彗星拦截器任务目标，但发现与预警流程为任务协作提供了检验。
articles.limitations: 彗星轨道周期等参数仍需更多观测数据修正；发现与确认过程均来自欧空局公告，未提供独立轨道复核结果。

facts.text: 欧空局10月19日宣布，欧几里得空间望远镜在9月16日至24日拍摄的图像中发现其第一颗此前未知的彗星。发现者、赫尔辛基大学博士生 Mikko Pöntinen 利用其开发的移动天体检测软件，在5个不同视野、共16次曝光中捕捉到该目标，并将观测报告提交国际天文联合会小行星中心。经地面天文台后续观测，该中心于10月8日确认其为彗星，编号 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)。

evidence.quote: The European Space Agency’s Euclid space telescope has discovered its first previously unknown comet, in images taken between 16 and 24 September 2026.
The MPC subsequently confirmed it as a comet on 8 October, and it is now identified as C/2026 S1 (Euclid).

facts.text: 该彗星距地球约13亿公里，位于行星轨道平面之外，绕太阳一周需数千年。欧几里得本为测绘深空星系设计，会刻意避开太阳系平面尘埃带，且采用步进凝视方式通常只观测每片天区一次，因此发现新彗星并不容易。

evidence.quote: The comet is located approximately 1.3 billion kilometres away from Earth, equivalent to the distance from the Sun to roughly between the orbits of Jupiter and Saturn.

Euclid deliberately avoids the asteroid- and comet-rich band of sky along the Solar System’s plane to reduce unwanted glare from dust that would hinder sensitive deep-sky imaging, making the discovery of new Solar System objects particularly challenging.

facts.text: 欧空局表示，这颗彗星不适合作为其未来彗星拦截器任务的目标，但此次发现与预警流程为两个任务团队后续协作提供了实战检验。

evidence.quote: While this particular comet is not a suitable candidate for Comet Interceptor, the process of discovery and alert gives us a real test case for how our two mission teams will coordinate in the future.

bilingual.title_en: Euclid Telescope Discovers First New Comet, C/2026 S1

sentences.en: On October 19, ESA announced that the Euclid space telescope had discovered its first previously unknown comet in images taken between September 16 and 24.
sentences.zh: 欧空局10月19日宣布，欧几里得空间望远镜在9月16日至24日拍摄的图像中发现其第一颗此前未知的彗星。

sentences.en: The discoverer, Mikko Pöntinen, a doctoral student at the University of Helsinki, captured the object in 16 exposures across 5 different fields of view using moving-object detection software he developed, and submitted an observation report to the Minor Planet Center of the International Astronomical Union.
sentences.zh: 发现者、赫尔辛基大学博士生 Mikko Pöntinen 利用其开发的移动天体检测软件，在5个不同视野、共16次曝光中捕捉到该目标，并将观测报告提交国际天文联合会小行星中心。

sentences.en: Following subsequent observations by ground-based observatories, the center confirmed on October 8 that it was a comet and designated it C/2026 S1 (Euclid).
sentences.zh: 经地面天文台后续观测，该中心于10月8日确认其为彗星，编号 C/2026 S1 (Euclid)。

sentences.en: The comet is about 1.3 billion kilometers from Earth, lies outside the plane of the planets' orbits, and takes thousands of years to complete one orbit around the Sun.
sentences.zh: 该彗星距地球约13亿公里，位于行星轨道平面之外，绕太阳一周需数千年。

sentences.en: Euclid was designed to map deep-space galaxies, deliberately avoids the dusty band of the solar system's plane, and uses a step-and-stare method that usually observes each patch of sky only once, so discovering a new comet is not easy.
sentences.zh: 欧几里得本为测绘深空星系设计，会刻意避开太阳系平面尘埃带，且采用步进凝视方式通常只观测每片天区一次，因此发现新彗星并不容易。

sentences.en: ESA said the comet is not suitable as a target for its future Comet Interceptor mission, but that this discovery and alert process provided a real-world test for subsequent collaboration between the two mission teams.
sentences.zh: 欧空局表示，这颗彗星不适合作为其未来彗星拦截器任务的目标，但此次发现与预警流程为两个任务团队后续协作提供了实战检验。

articles.event_key: NVIDIA|完成|容错量子计算纪录模拟
articles.title: NVIDIA 在 JUPITER 超算上完成104量子比特容错量子计算模拟
articles.summary: NVIDIA 称在德国于利希超算中心 JUPITER 上完成迄今最大规模容错量子计算模拟，规模104量子比特，验证 magic state cultivation 路径，声称较此前方法减少90%物理量子比特需求。
articles.new_facts: NVIDIA 10月19日宣布在德国于利希超算中心 JUPITER（欧洲首台百亿亿次超算）上完成104量子比特容错量子计算模拟，称这是迄今最大规模的容错量子处理器综合模拟。该模拟在真实噪声条件下验证 magic state cultivation 方法，NVIDIA 称该方法所需物理量子比特比此前方法少90%。JUPITER 使用 NVIDIA GH200 超级芯片，项目在 NVAQC 的 GB200 NVL72 系统上开发，最终扩展至8192块 GPU。模拟基于 cuQuantum 与 CUDA-Q。
articles.limitations: 模拟规模、性能提升与量子比特节省比例均为 NVIDIA 单方面公布，未提供独立复现或同行评审结果；该工作为经典计算机上的模拟，并非在真实量子硬件上实现容错计算。

facts.text: NVIDIA 10月19日宣布，其研究人员在欧洲首台百亿亿次超算 JUPITER 上完成了104量子比特的容错量子计算模拟，称这是迄今对容错量子处理器规模最大、最完整的模拟。JUPITER 位于德国于利希超算中心，使用 NVIDIA GH200 超级芯片。

evidence.quote: The 104-qubit simulation is the largest comprehensive simulation of a fault-tolerant quantum computing system to date
Running on a system of NVIDIA GH200 superchips at Jülich Supercomputing Centre

facts.text: 该模拟在包含真实噪声的条件下验证了 magic state cultivation 方法。NVIDIA 称，这种方法所需的物理量子比特比此前方法少90%，有助于缩短通向实用量子计算的路径。magic state 是容错量子计算中持续消耗的一种特殊量子态，其制备效率直接影响系统规模。

evidence.quote: The simulation validates a quantum computing approach that uses 90% fewer physical qubits than previous methods
this work simulates magic-state cultivation under realistic hardware noise, helping researchers understand the impact of errors.

facts.text: 项目先在 NVIDIA 加速量子研究中心的 GB200 NVL72 系统上开发，随后扩展至 JUPITER 的8192块 GPU，并使用 cuQuantum 软件和 CUDA-Q 平台的容错逻辑层。NVIDIA 称，该流程将原本需数周的模拟缩短至数天。

evidence.quote: An NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 system at the NVIDIA Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC) served as the development platform
enabling researchers to scale tests from four GPUs to hundreds before moving to 8,192 GPUs on JUPITER.

bilingual.title_en: NVIDIA Completes 104-Qubit Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Simulation on JUPITER Supercomputer

sentences.en: NVIDIA announced on October 19 that its researchers completed a 104-qubit fault-tolerant quantum computing simulation on JUPITER, Europe's first exascale supercomputer, calling it the largest and most complete simulation of a fault-tolerant quantum processor to date.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 10月19日宣布，其研究人员在欧洲首台百亿亿次超算 JUPITER 上完成了104量子比特的容错量子计算模拟，称这是迄今对容错量子处理器规模最大、最完整的模拟。

sentences.en: JUPITER is located at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre in Germany and uses NVIDIA GH200 superchips.
sentences.zh: JUPITER 位于德国于利希超算中心，使用 NVIDIA GH200 超级芯片。

sentences.en: The simulation validated the magic state cultivation method under conditions that include realistic noise.
sentences.zh: 该模拟在包含真实噪声的条件下验证了 magic state cultivation 方法。

sentences.en: NVIDIA said this method requires 90% fewer physical qubits than previous methods, which helps shorten the path to practical quantum computing.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 称，这种方法所需的物理量子比特比此前方法少90%，有助于缩短通向实用量子计算的路径。

sentences.en: Magic states are a special type of quantum state that is continuously consumed in fault-tolerant quantum computing, and their preparation efficiency directly affects system scale.
sentences.zh: magic state 是容错量子计算中持续消耗的一种特殊量子态，其制备效率直接影响系统规模。

sentences.en: The project was first developed on the GB200 NVL72 system at the NVIDIA Accelerated Quantum Research Center and was then scaled to 8,192 GPUs on JUPITER, using cuQuantum software and the fault-tolerant logical layer of the CUDA-Q platform.
sentences.zh: 项目先在 NVIDIA 加速量子研究中心的 GB200 NVL72 系统上开发，随后扩展至 JUPITER 的8192块 GPU，并使用 cuQuantum 软件和 CUDA-Q 平台的容错逻辑层。

sentences.en: NVIDIA said the workflow shortened simulations that would originally have taken weeks to a few days.
sentences.zh: NVIDIA 称，该流程将原本需数周的模拟缩短至数天。
